verdict: Semi rally on Nebius GPU/CPU rental hikes (+17-41%); SNDK S&P 100 inclusion +11%; ALAB +8% on Leo SMC launch; Fed rate hike (first in 3yr) crushes solar -5 to -6%.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (Sept 17–19, 2026)

**Nebius GPU/CPU rental price hikes trigger broad SOX +3.1% rally (Sept 17)**
Nebius raised NVIDIA GPU rates +17–21%, AMD EPYC CPU +25%, memory +41% — clearest spot-demand confirmation in months. AMD +6.3% (EPYC directly cited); NVDA +2.54% (Jensen Huang: doubling chip shipments next year); MU +5.5% (pre-earnings momentum, Sept 30 report).

**SK Hynix shipping 16-layer 48 GB HBM4 in volume for NVIDIA Rubin**
Micron: 16-layer sampled, not volume. Samsung: 12-layer in final NVIDIA qualification. HBM4 supply remains SK Hynix-centric near-term.

**DRAM bottleneck shifts: CoWoS packaging → raw wafer supply (404K, Sept 19)**
DDR4 spot at fresh tracker high ($45.79, Sept 16). Week-over-week prices flat. Memflation continues but rate-of-change decelerating sharply vs. Q1's +90–95% QoQ.

**SNDK +11.2% (Sept 18): S&P 100 inclusion + $14B buyback**
SanDisk joins S&P 100 on Sept 21 alongside Dell, Palo Alto, Arista. Highest-conviction memory catalyst of the week.

**ALAB +7.88% (Sept 17): Leo Smart Memory Controller launch**
Astera Labs unveiled Leo SMC for AI rack-scale memory pooling — directly targets the inference memory bottleneck.

**COHR +5–7% (Sept 16–18): POLS portfolio for AI datacenters (Sept 17)**
Coherent launched C-band amplified Pluggable Optical Line System (POLS). InP in formal allocation; Coherent retaining all output internally; LITE fully committed through 2027.

**CRDO +4–4.5% (Sept 17–18): ZeroFlap 224G / 1.6T transceiver launch**
Credo launched 224G optical transceiver targeting 1.6T AI networking.

**NOK +5.03% (Sept 17): Multi-catalyst burst**
Rosenblatt initiates Buy/$15 PT (AI optical play); Telxius selects Nokia 800G for Europe/US/LatAm; UK MoD C3IA MoU; Google €13B Finland buildout ecosystem exposure; expanded Microsoft partnership.

**Meta MTIA Iris in production; BofA: $8.5B 2027 savings from in-house ASICs (Sept 17)**
Structural medium-term bear for NVIDIA GPU demand at scale; near-term NVDA demand unaffected.

**Solar selloff: Fed rate hike (first in 3 years) + FSLR ITC patent loss**
ARRY −6.1%, NXT −5.5%, ENPH −5%, FSLR −4 to −5%. Section 232 tariffs (15% + MIP, effective Dec 4) pre-existing overhang. FSLR Q3 earnings Oct 29.

---

## Watchlist Movers

| Name | Move | Catalyst |
|------|------|----------|
| SNDK | +11.2% | S&P 100 inclusion (Sept 21) + $14B buyback |
| ALAB | +7.9% | Leo Smart Memory Controller launch |
| AMD | +6.3% | Nebius EPYC CPU rental hike (+25%) |
| MU | +5.5% | Sector rally + pre-earnings momentum (Sept 30 EPS) |
| NOK | +5.0% | Rosenblatt Buy, Telxius 800G win, UK defense MoU |
| COHR | +5–7% | POLS portfolio launch; AI optical demand |
| ARRY | −6.1% | Fed rate hike + solar sector selloff |
| NXT | −5.5% | Fed rate hike + solar sector selloff |
| ENPH | −5.0% | Fed rate hike (Goldman PT↑$57 overwhelmed by rate fears) |
| FSLR | −4 to −5% | ITC patent case loss + Fed rate hike |
| CRDO | +4–4.5% | ZeroFlap 224G (1.6T) transceiver launch |
| MRVL | ~+3–4% | Azure Payment HSM v2 (Microsoft partnership, Sept 17) |
| NVDA | +2.5% | Jensen Huang doubling shipments comment + sector rally |

No notable catalyst: WDC, STX, RMBS, MRAM, LITE (post-earnings drift), CIEN (recovery), NOW, ZS, CRM, TSLA, HIVE, AMPX, GDDY (lawsuit overhang predates window), ALMU (CHIPS Act LOI was Sept 16).

---

## Context vs. Baseline

- HBM4 ramp on track; SK Hynix leading. Correction-after-2026 risk not yet confirmed.
- Hyperscaler capex intact (~$725B combined, +77% YoY); no guide-down.
- ASIC threat building: Meta MTIA Iris in production + $8.5B 2027 savings is a structural medium-term NVDA overhang.
- InP allocation confirmed tight through 2027; 800G/1.6T transceiver lead times >40 weeks.
- Fed rate hike (first in 3 years) is real headwind for solar project financing on top of Section 232 tariffs.

---

## Signals Flashing

| Signal | Direction | Bull/Bear |
|--------|-----------|-----------|
| DRAM/HBM pricing | Flat WoW; DDR4 spot at highs; deceleration in rate-of-change | Neutral → mild bull |
| HBM4 ramp | SK Hynix 16-layer in volume; tight supply confirmed | Bull |
| Hyperscaler capex | $725B intact; NVDA $108B Q3 guide beat | Bull |
| AMD/Helios + Custom ASIC | Helios volume ramp; MTIA Iris production | Mixed |
| Optical/InP | InP allocation; COHR/CRDO product launches | Bull |
| Solar | Fed rate hike + tariff overhang + FSLR patent loss | Bear |

---

## Most Important Development

Nebius GPU/CPU/memory rental hikes (+17–41%) provided the week's clearest real-economy demand confirmation, triggering the broadest semi rally in months. Simultaneously, the first Fed rate hike in 3 years hit solar hard (−5 to −6%). SNDK's S&P 100 forced-buying event and ALAB's Leo memory controller are the week's highest-conviction name-specific catalysts.
